name: South Osteth Peak
title: South Osteth Peak
summary: An unclimbable mountain peak near Baishi, reached only by the South Osteth Peak portal, with Esper Ursuins and a Mountain Climber exploration marker (acpedia). In the kit it is a flat snow-and-ice summit plateau about 110 m across at z 520, the highest ground for kilometres. The Old Keep stands on a ledge 170 m east and 180 m below, and the Linvak ranges and the coast round Lin lie all around.

shots.standingOrder: Hover 22 m over the snow summit of South Osteth Peak and turn slowly clockwise from the northern ranges toward the Old Keep's ledge and the sea beyond Lin, the afternoon sun behind; never descend.
shots.notes: Pano slice from 22 m over the 520 m snow summit, the highest ground for kilometres, yawing 92 degrees clockwise in the edit window from the northern Linvak ranges to east-south-east over the Old Keep's ledge, Lin and the sea. The afternoon sun (0.65) sits behind the turn. A pano does not frame its subject by design: the summit is directly below and the vista is the subject, so in-frame reads 0%.
